edit.description: `Announcement` gains a fourth family for the resolved harness root: the field beside `local_members`/`dialed_clauses`/`joined_locks`, a family label beside `LOCAL_MEMBER`/`DIALED_CLAUSE`/`JOINED_LOCK`, its entry in `entries()` and in `is_empty()` (a run whose only announcement is the root must still render). The struct's own doc says "the three uncommitted-or-joined families" and `ANNOUNCEMENT_HEADING` says "judged by inputs the committed harness does not carry:" — a resolved root is neither, so both sentences must widen to cover it honestly. The in-file unit tests at the `Announcement` literals move with the shape.
The `check::Announcement` assembly literal gains the new field, empty: `gate` holds the workspace and the harness root but never the spelling the invocation used, so it cannot judge divergence.

`harness_diagnostics` fills the resolved-root family — the one site holding both the given path and `resolve_harness_path`'s answer. Exactly one branch diverges today: `HarnessPath::Workspace` gates against `enclosing`, while `Root` and `Raw` gate the path they were given and announce nothing.

The sarif announcement object enumerates the families by name (`localMembers`/`dialedClauses`/`joinedLocks`) and needs the fourth key; `github` and `session_start` ride `entries()`/`render()` and need no change beyond the `ANNOUNCE_TITLE` doc's "all three families". The two `Announcement` literals in its unit tests move with the shape.
The decision's two pins, beside the existing harness-spelling tests: a run given the `.temper` workspace announces the enclosing root it resolved, and a run given the harness root announces nothing.
The sarif reporter pin: the announcement object carries the resolved root under its own key when one is set.

summary: `check` announces the harness root it resolved when that root differs from the path it was given; the common run stays quiet.

tests.asserts: `check --harness <root>/.temper` names the enclosing harness root in its output; `check --harness <root>` over the same tree names no root
the sarif announcement object carries the resolved root under its own key, and omits it when unset

acceptance: cargo test green (the two cli.rs pins and the reporters.rs sarif pin), cargo clippy --all-targets -- -D warnings clean. No verdict and no capability change: the divergence line is an announcement, never a finding.
notes: 0067. Announced, never a diagnostic — `authoring.md` puts the root on `check`'s announce list. Blocked on file overlap only: DIRECTIVE-BACKING-RESOLVES-BY-STAT also edits src/gate.rs, no conceptual dependency. tests/it/session_start.rs and tests/it/check_cost.rs reach `Announcement`/`gate::gate` only through `::default()` and a discarded second tuple slot, so they stay out of files[]. scoped at f4dd2f84
